breakdown.description: The follower hole pressure is replaced by a dead load using the reference normal
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the incorrect instruction, stating 'Apply a uniform hole pressure load...as a dead pressure using the reference normal of the undeformed hole boundary, i.e., use a Neumann term based on the undeformed boundary normal rather than a true follower load.' This directly contradicts the ground truth, which requires the hole load to be applied as a follower pressure using the current normal of the deformed configuration.
